h: That reel yesterday morning? That was a sale going out the door.
t: One envelope, into the blue box. That was the Brady. Filmed the mail run, posted it, and the card in the envelope was a real order — sold, sleeved, bagged, gone.

h: I spent last night mapping every card shop in Missouri.
t: Three hundred ten shops banked so far, and the drag's still rolling. Real shops, real sellers, real storefronts — every one of them with a story I haven't read yet.

h: Two cards in my own store were lying about their names.
t: The box check caught both of them. One was a Red-Eyes B. Chick wearing a Dragon's name.

h: The posts send more buyers than eBay search does now.
t: Not a guess. The last thirty days proved it. External views just passed organic search as my biggest source of listing views.

h: My store woke up wearing its own logo.
t: Over fifteen hundred listings branded overnight, while I slept. Every one of them used to wear the same template as everybody else's store.

h: Christmas stuff comes out of the shed tonight.
t: Foggy morning, warm afternoon — good garage weather. Dad stuff first, store stuff keeps ticking behind it. New listings are landing about one an hour while I'm out there. The…
